title: wt spec frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block of a docs/specs/NNNN-slug.md file.

id.description: Canonical id, e.g. SPEC-0001. Must match the file's number.

status.description: Lifecycle stage. See SCHEMA.md for the state machine.

created.description: ISO date the spec was created.

updated.description: ISO date of the last substantive edit (optional).

milestone.description: Optional grouping / phase label used by the ledger (e.g. 'M1: packaging').

kind.description: Spec category; controls kind-specific lint rules. Absent = 'feature'.

parent.description: The epic (kind: epic) this spec is a child of.

depends_on.description: Specs that must land before this one.

supersedes.description: Specs whose decisions this one replaces.

superseded_by.description: Set on an old spec when a newer one replaces it. Requires status=superseded.

source_idea.description: The org idea this spec was promoted from (its :ID: or file:line), set by `wt spec new --from-idea` (SPEC-0013).

allOf.$comment: A superseded spec must name what replaced it.
